name: Kurumi mail
description: Owner-only email drafting and delivery behind the shared confirmation gate.

allowedRecipients.description: Recipient allowlist (exact addresses). Empty means no recipient is permitted; there is no wildcard.

allowedSenders.description: Trusted inbox sender allowlist (exact addresses). Unlisted or SPF/DKIM-failed senders require per-email owner confirmation.

feedbackActions.description: Mail actions that expose feedback. Defaults to all mail actions.

policyAdapter.description: Registered policy id to use. Defaults to 'default'. An unknown id fails loudly at load.

storeAdapter.description: Registered store id to use. Defaults to 'sqlite'. An unknown id fails loudly at load.
